cards.think1: Vertical component holds weight mg = T cos(theta); horizontal component accelerates mass m a = T sin(theta).
cards.feedback: Good derivation of lateral acceleration from tilt angle.

openQuestions: thrust size with gravity: For a=(0,2,0) wrote T=3*2=6 N. Gravity must be added first: T=m*sqrt(ax^2+ay^2+(az+g)^2)=30.04 N.
tilt theta vs roll/pitch: Thought theta/phi are pitch/roll. theta = total lean from vertical, phi = lean direction; roll and pitch split that lean into two axes.
